title: Volatility-band thrust through a two-hour exponential average

source.title: Keltner Channel Strategy (StockSharp API examples), via lab hypothesis H-025

rule_summary: Two-hour blocks from finished hourly bars (even UTC hours), orders at the next hourly open. Centre line is a 20-block exponential average; width is 1.5 times a 20-block Wilder average true range; upper band is centre plus width. Buy when a block closes above the upper band while the previous block closed at or under its own upper band, and the close is above the 100-block mean, nothing open. Sell when a block closes under the centre line. Stop two percent under the fill. Buys only in blocks opening 00:00 to 16:00 UTC; flat by the 23:00 UTC open or after twelve hours.
mechanism: A fresh close outside the volatility band while trending up marks a burst of directional demand; stop orders and momentum followers add to it for several hours. Parent numbers kept, block length cut from one day to two hours. Expected gross move about 0.8% on winners; a design estimate.
